message.content: {"summary":"Your GBR reef-monitoring mission design is well structured and addresses all major requirements: launch site/vehicle, SSO with full COEs, ground contacts, duration and EOL, supported by STK evidence. To reach the top of the rubric, resolve the EOL contradictions, add formal figure captions and software files, and replace Wikipedia/bare-URL references with proper sources.","next_steps":["Resolve the EOL contradiction: you state the satellite has no thrusters yet also describe a manoeuvre at EOL; clearly state whether deorbit is passive (drag sail) or active, and make the reasoning consistent throughout.","Add numbered figures with formal captions (e.g. 'Figure 1: STK 3D view of orbit, 12 hours apart') and include your STK software files in an appendix, explicitly referenced in the Mission Design section.","Replace Wikipedia [6] and bare URLs with authoritative sources (titles, authors, dates) and fix typos such as 'low resolution images which is also desirable' (should be 'not desirable'), 'a Earth observation' and 'for the purposed of'."],"criteria":{"C1":"Accomplished (8/10). Your Introduction clearly covers the primary mission (fluid-lensing reef monitoring), rationale, single-spacecraft justification, and users/operator/funding with cited literature. To reach the top of the range, expand on customer detail—how CSIRO/BOM and others would actually access and use the data.","C2":"Accomplished (7/10). All major requirements are addressed: Vega E from Kourou with rationale, 600 km SSO with full COE table, manoeuvre statement, ground station access (~10 min contacts), 5-year duration and EOL, with STK screenshots. To improve, resolve the thruster/drag-sail contradiction, justify the RAAN choice and the two-daily-window claim quantitatively, and include software files.","C3":"Accomplished (7/10). Your conclusions are specific and trace back to the analysis, including honest caveats about Vega E availability. To strengthen, briefly summarise the communications and EOL outcomes quantitatively (contact frequency, deorbit approach) so the conclusion reflects all evidence.","C4":"Adequate (5/10). Your report has a logical structure and executive summary, but figures lack formal numbers/captions, the bibliography uses Wikipedia and bare URLs, and there are writing errors. The next level requires consistent formatting, properly cited references matching the list, and polished spelling/grammar throughout."}}
